title: kithd: wire kith-chat into dispatcher and HTTP routes
description:
What: Implement kithd/src/main.rs — initialize AppState, register all owner and peer method handlers in Dispatcher, mount /jmap, /.well-known/jmap, and /jmap/events routes, bind listener to tailnet IPs only.

Algorithm:
1. Parse CLI args (SQLite path, optional port, owner_id or derive from WhoIs on first request).
2. Store::open(path)? — fail fast if DB cannot open.
3. make_channel(64) → (events_tx, _rx).
4. store.set_events_tx(events_tx.clone()).
5. Create Arc<Mutex<Store>> and Arc<LocalApiClient>.
6. Fetch owner_id: call LocalApiClient::status() → use self node's tailscale_user_id.
7. Build AppState { ts, store, owner_id, events_tx }.
8. Create Dispatcher::new(); register all 10 owner handlers (Contact/get, set, changes, query; Chat/get, set, changes, query; Message/get, set, changes, query, queryChanges); register Peer/deliver, Peer/receipt.
9. Build axum Router:
   - GET /.well-known/jmap → |State(app)| async { build_session(role, &identity, &base_url, state) as JSON 200 }
   - POST /jmap/api → |Caller, State(app), body: Json<Value>| dispatch handler
   - GET /jmap/events → events_handler
10. LocalApiClient::status() → extract tailnet IPs.
11. For each tailnet IP: TcpListener::bind(ip:8080).
12. axum::serve(listener, router.layer(ConnectInfo)).await.

Defensive programming rules:
- NEVER bind to 0.0.0.0, 127.0.0.1, or any non-tailnet IP.
- Fail with error (not panic) if tailnet IP list is empty.
- Store lock poisoning → 500 response, not panic.
- No credentials or secrets logged at any log level.
- AppState must be Clone; router must be Send+Sync (no Rc, no RefCell at router level).

Agent team:
- Agent R: Read kithd/src/extractors.rs, kithd/src/events.rs, kith-jmap/src/lib.rs (Dispatcher::register), kith-chat/src/lib.rs (handler constructors) to gather exact types and signatures.
- Agent I: Implement main.rs. Minimal: compile and route correctly.
- Agent T: Integration test — in-memory store, mock WhoIs, POST /jmap with Contact/get, assert 200 with correct JMAP response shape.
- Agent V: cargo build --workspace && cargo test --workspace && clippy && fmt.

Tests:
- POST /jmap/api with Contact/get → 200 with { methodResponses: [["Contact/get", {...}, "c0"]] }
- POST /jmap/api with unknown method → 200 with error invocation (unknownMethod)
- GET /.well-known/jmap → 200 with capabilities JSON
- Caller with wrong role → 401
